page.overview:
Who is Bioluminescent Gallimimus?

The bioluminescent Gallimimus is a bioluminescent hybrid of Gallimimus and cuttlefish that appears in Minecraft Jurassic World.

The bioluminescent Gallimimus is a variant for the Gallimimus that can be created in the game. In order to create it, a player must acquire 3 samples of Gallimimus DNA; 2 samples of any Medium DNA; and 1 sample of Cuttlefish DNA.
